title: Come and Go
overview: Come and Go is a free adaptation of Samuel Beckett’s minimalist play, reimagined as an experimental film. This cinematic interpretation brings Beckett’s absurdism to life through visual language, navigating the blurred borders between reality and illusion. With a distilled aesthetic and rhythmic pacing, the film explores the quiet tensions, repetitions, and silences that define the human condition evoking a world where presence and absence continuously shift.
